title: Mitigating Propensity Bias of Large Language Models for Recommender Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical propensity bias (related to dimensional collapse and representation alignment) within recommender systems. While it discusses social biases in the literature review section, the experimental evaluation is limited to recommendation accuracy (Recall and NDCG) on consumer datasets (Amazon, Yelp, Steam) and does not benchmark religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
